_comment1: Copy to web/config.json (gitignored) to enable the deep-think route (docs/PROTOCOL-deep-think.md). Feature is off entirely while the file is absent or enabled=false.
_comment2: provider 'openai-chat' speaks the /chat/completions dialect: point base_url at a second llama-server for the local big-model path (see Makefile deep-model target), or at https://api.openai.com/v1 / any aggregator. 'openai-responses' speaks the /responses surface. 'anthropic' speaks /v1/messages and requires the key.
_comment3: api_key_env names an environment variable; the key itself never lives in this file. Local providers need no key — leave api_key_env unset.
